import numpy as np

# Read MSD data, skipping header line
msd_data = np.loadtxt('msd.txt', skiprows=1)

# Convert timesteps to ps (timestep = 0.001 ps, output every 100 steps)
times = np.arange(len(msd_data)) * 0.1  # 100 steps * 0.001 ps = 0.1 ps per output

# Find index corresponding to 50 ps
start_idx = int(50 / 0.1)

# Calculate numerical derivative of MSD
msd_derivative = np.gradient(msd_data[start_idx:])

# Find where derivative suddenly increases (melting point)
# Use a more robust threshold based on the initial solid phase
initial_mean = np.mean(msd_derivative[:100])
initial_std = np.std(msd_derivative[:100])
threshold = initial_mean + 5*initial_std  # Using 5 sigma threshold for clear transition

melting_idx = np.where(msd_derivative > threshold)[0][0] + start_idx

# Calculate diffusion coefficient from MSD after melting
# D = MSD/(6*t) in steady state
time_after_melting = times[melting_idx:] - times[melting_idx]
msd_after_melting = msd_data[melting_idx:]

# Fit line to get diffusion coefficient
slope, _ = np.polyfit(time_after_melting, msd_after_melting, 1)
D = slope/(6*1e-12)  # Convert to m²/s (time was in ps)

print(f"{D:.6e}")
